description:
The market value of our 'Aniseed Syrup' inventory has dropped. You need to adjust the total asset value of this item to $200.00 in Manager.io without changing the quantity on hand.

1. Enable the 'Inventory Revaluations' module in Settings if it is not already visible.
2. Create a new Inventory Revaluation entry.
3. Set the Item to 'Aniseed Syrup'.
4. Set the New Amount to 200.00.
5. Save the entry.

Start from the Northwind Traders business dashboard. Login is administrator (no password).
